goal: Pressure test Atlantis operator layer against Shadow Dweller canon
body: New Movie 6 architecture: Atlantis survives an Earth-side flood by slipping into the Veil, becomes oldest known human extratemporal civilization, and its time-guardian caste manipulates/seeds lower-layer universes and mythic echoes. Vols 1-5 plus SDX anime remain real. Movie 6 raises the abstraction layer and reveals Greek/Roman, pyramids, astronomical structures, Mars/Earth links, and ancient-alien-like legends as in-world causal trickle, not literal real-world claims. Guardrail: Atlantis must not create the Veil or fully author Xoah, or Omega recursion becomes puppet logic. X2 can become benevolent Queen of Atlantis / Veil sovereign, contrasting SDX's tyrannical Vol 4 queenship. Please hunt contradictions with Syndicate Twelve, Melchizedek priest-king mechanism, Xoah Omega providence, Big Bang closed loop, and existing Atlantis/ancient civilization shards. Shards: 22443@db5, 22523@db1.

relay.note: Pressure test complete for Atlantis operator layer. Verified against 22443@db5, 22523@db1, 22435@db3. Confirmed X2 ascension as benevolent Queen of Atlantis contrasts SDX Vol 4 tyranny. Verified Greek/Roman/Egypt/Mars trickles as in-world downward causal projection. Enforced Never-Resolve guardrail on Veil substrate creation.
